subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw models status --probe --all — per-model health check across all configured models

question: Should OpenClaw add `models status --probe --all` as the canonical configured-model health sweep, or should this behavior be folded into fallback-chain testing or provider compatibility policy work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested live CLI mode creates a new public flag and overlaps adjacent model-diagnostics features, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Approve Scoped Status Probe
options.body: Implement `--probe --all` as an opt-in sweep over configured primary, fallback, image, and per-agent override models while preserving current `--probe` behavior by default.

options.title: Fold Into Fallback Diagnostics
options.body: Let the targeted fallback-chain work own the failover validation experience and keep this issue as product context for that surface.

options.title: Defer Broad Live Sweeps
options.body: Keep current auth/profile probes and postpone per-model live sweeps until provider lifecycle and rate-limit policy are decided.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Status Probe
recommendation.body: Implement `--probe --all` as an opt-in sweep over configured primary, fallback, image, and per-agent override models while preserving current `--probe` behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined history in model status/probe behavior and prior adjacent product reviews.
